text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down a back alley
with Transcend...

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu...
Brace yourself, Transcend.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you've certainly led us on quite a chase.
But today is the day...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa-hoh... Looks like we're completely surrounded, Trai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Maybe I went a little too far with that prank.
choice_data_list: Ah... How do we get through this!?
Yeah... How do we get through this?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What can I even do...?
I've been dodging the issue until now, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I won't run or hide anymore.
That's right, without being afraid..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright. I'll give you autographs, so please line up. No pushing, no pushing.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thanks, Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
You never let me before, after all!
Going on like, 'You'd better stay away
from dangerous informants~' and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Up until now, well, um...
I guess I was just a bit shy, you know?
Here, hand over the autograph board.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Scribble, scribble... done.
Alright, next person~.

Transcend used to be awkward when interacting with fans.
However, she's changed a bit recently.

She seems to be gradually getting used
to being in the spotlight. At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oryo? What are you talking about, Trainy?
choice_data_list: You can run proudly even in a big race, right?
You can run proudly even in a big race, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's what it is... True.
At first, racing in the spotlight made me feel restless, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't seem like my memory's
blanking out anymore.
Even in decent-level races."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then... are you starting to think about it?
Like, deciding on our target race and all.

Up until now, to help her get used to the public eye,
we deliberately refrained from deciding on target races.
Still, it's about time we set some firm hurdles for her to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's find out which races our rivals
are likely to enter.
Leave the scouting to this info broker!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, a race where tough rivals show up
and we can have a thrilling showdown would be...
choice_data_list: No, try looking for a race without rivals.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, not running together,
more like avoiding each other instead?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's still too early to compete with such strong opponents.
Yeah, it's still too early to compete against strong opponents.

text_block_list.text: "Everything has its stages. I wanted to avoid jumping straight into challenging my rivals without proper preparation."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, that's a bit of a shame.
Still, I'll take that into account, and..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The condition is a Classic-class dirt race. Now, let's look for a race where top contenders aren't likely to show up...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai-chan. How about this one?
The GⅢ Leopard Stakes held in August.

It's a summer regional race
held at Niigata Racecourse.

The competition will probably be thinner than at a big racecourse.
It seemed like a reasonable goal.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so you'll adopt it then.
Glad I could provide some valuable info.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainy,
I'll leave the training to you~.
Consider it an equivalent exchange for the investigation.

The division of roles between Transcend and myself
has been working out very well so far.

Let's keep polishing your skills,
aiming for the Leopard Stakes this summer.
